reason: The plugin is best classified as a Navigation & Panels tool because its primary user-facing function is a session History tab in DeepSeek Harness that renders a clickable directory of user messages and jumps to selected messages. The README describes auto-filtering to user-only entries, automatic older-history paging, and in-chat jump behavior; package metadata shows a web client DSH bundle with `client`/`ui-conversation` integration, confirming a UI navigation purpose rather than code-generation, data export, or external service integration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，在会话中提供 History 标签页，将用户消息整理为可点击的目录，并支持点击后切回聊天视图定位到对应消息。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a History tab, displays user messages as a clickable directory, and lets users jump directly to selected messages in the Chat view.

capabilities: Builds a conversation-history view panel within the DeepSeek Harness session UI
Reads chat session state to list user messages as a navigable directory
Loads older chat pages while the view is open to complete the message listing
Scrolls and highlights the selected message in the Chat view after selection

reasons.code: `dsh` manifest declares a web client extension with client injection and exports `./client`, indicating it is a UI plugin.

README states the plugin adds a "History" session tab, auto-generates entries from user messages only, auto-paginates older history (50 messages/page), and supports click-to-jump scrolling/flash behavior.
Repository topic and metadata identify it as a DSH plugin package with a client-facing scope and public publication readiness.
